svg.title: Models larger than memory
svg.desc: A model does not have to fit in memory: Splaude streams the experts it is not using from the SSD. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO IQ3_S is 83.6 GB. llama.cpp keeps the whole model in memory, 83.6 GB; it was not run on this model, and its bar is the memory it would hold. Splaude streams experts from the SSD and runs it in 48 GB, at a median decode of 23.5 to 29.5 tokens per second over four full Claude Code runs on real repositories. Measured on an M4 Pro with 48 GB.
svg.text: A model does not have to fit in memory: Splaude streams the experts it is not using from the SSD.
llama.cpp: keeps the whole model in memory
Splaude: streams experts from the SSD
median decode over four full Claude Code runs
Measured on an M4 Pro with 48 GB: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO IQ3_S (83.6 GB) through multi-hour Claude Code sessions.
llama.cpp was not run on this model; its bar is the memory it would hold. Details: docs/claude-code-benchmarks.md
